_comment: Starting geometry-backed placeholder mounting data. AABBs are measured through production CreatureBody._fit and skin-correct RenderBounds at rest, not inferred from declared collision height. Seat/back anchors remain conservative anatomical estimates within those envelopes; no visual, animated-seat, mounted-network, or swimming acceptance is claimed. Re-measure and obtain blind rendered acceptance when each replacement lands.
_comment_coordinates: All offsets are creature-root-local metres at body_scale=1. surface_origin_offset_m adds to sea level to position the creature root. mount_offset is rider HIP anchor; production rider seat_drop_m=0.92 lowers trainer art from that anchor. All proposed trainer art origins exceed sea level by at least0.08m. Root architecture must scale offsets consistently for non-unit individuals.
_comment_tuning: Starting land multipliers multiply production human walk speed; these prioritize species swim identities without making every placeholder a superior land sprinter. Dismount distances exceed fitted half-width +0.4m human radius +0.25m clearance, rounded upward. Actual dismount placement must still query collision and water safety.
_comment_scale_2026_09_07: Every spatial measurement except saddle_scale was uniformly grown with its Water target body by tools/art_pipeline/creature_scale_ladder.py. The player-sized saddle remains unchanged; mount/saddle anchors, surface offset, dismount clearance, fitted AABB and collision radius all track the larger creature.

water_aquaryn._comment_seat: Proposed seat around central torso, behind centre. Y derived conservatively inside fitted envelope; AABB cannot identify anatomical back or animation deformation. Production saddle reused at explicit scale; its full rest bounds stay above sea at this proposed origin.
replacement_requires: retune mount and saddle offsets against actual back

water_mosshell._comment_seat: F36#1 installed Mosshell correction: the Water form deliberately reuses the Meadows model, whose fitted shell reaches 2.50m at this central seat band. The r4 blind frame found the rider sunk in the shell; the old pelvis anchor at 2.00m was half a metre inside it. The pelvis is now 2.49m, on the shell line and inside the 2.50m grown body, with the saddle centre at 2.275714m preserving their original separation. Actual seated contact and the separate faint-on-shell-rim defect still require matched engine capture and code-blind judgement.
replacement_requires: retune mount and saddle offsets against actual back

water_sirenseal._comment_seat: F36#1 installed Sirenseal correction, restart r2 (17 Oct): r1 blind judging (3/3) found the rider at (0,2.05,0.55)m pinned against the near-vertical neck/mane slope with nothing under them. The posed ride mesh, fitted to 3.70m, has a horizontal lower back behind the mane: top about 0.94m at z=-0.38m, 1.14m at z=-0.18m, then rising steeply to 1.65m by z=0.22m. The pelvis now sits on that back line at (0,1.16,-0.2)m and the saddle centre at (0,0.958182,-0.2)m, keeping their 0.201818m separation. With the -0.706364m surface origin the swimming rider stays about 0.45m above the sea. Actual seated contact still requires matched engine capture and code-blind judgement.
